scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare; recompute from raw DFT artifacts infeasible as verifier sandbox cannot run DFT, and agent only submits final computed properties. Directional tolerances for masses and formation energy, symmetric for bandgap.

outputs.description: Predicted properties of the ground-state structure of CaZn2N2: direct bandgap, hole effective mass, electron effective mass, and formation energy per atom. Values must be obtained from the DFT workflow steps above.

output_contract.notes: The agent must execute all process steps to obtain the properties. The checker will compare each reported quantity to hidden gold values with directional tolerances that reward meeting or exceeding the paper's quality (e.g., smaller effective mass, more negative formation energy).

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for scoring the four properties of CaZn2N2 based on paper's reported theoretical results.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: direct bandgap 1.83 eV, hole effective mass 0.9 m0, electron effective mass 0.2 m0, formation energy stable (below hull) with a representative value of -150 meV/atom used for scoring threshold.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper's main text and underlying data; formation energy set to -150 meV/atom to represent stable (well below hull) consistent with solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are from paper's reported theoretical results; formation energy figure is a representative stable value chosen to enable threshold scoring; a correct re-run will likely obtain a negative formation energy.
